newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore, Australian navies start joint exercise.
newsitem.headline: Singapore, Australian navies start joint exercise.

text.p: The Singapore and Australian navies started a week-long annual exercise on Friday in waters off northern Australia, they said in a joint statement.
Eight Australian navy ships, including the guided missile frigate HMAS Adelaide, and two Singapore navy missile corvettes are taking part in the exercise, the statement said.
"The exercise provides the navies of Australia and Singapore with the opportunity to work together in the areas of anti-submarine warfare, over-the-horizon targeting and anti-air warfare," it said.
"Such exercises...help to strengthen the capabilities of the two armed forces and contribute to regional security."
